title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: Company Personnel
tiers.description: All directors, officers and employees of GWA Group Limited and its related companies. Subject to the general insider trading prohibition (4.3-4.4), the ban on trading in securities of other companies while holding Inside Information about them (4.10), and the additional prohibition on active short-term trading (4.4).

tiers.name: Directors and Executives
tiers.description: Directors and executives, plus any other officers or employees the Managing Director designates from time to time (4.5.1). Subject to the Window Period trading restriction (4.5), the hedging ban on unvested incentive securities (4.7), and the margin loan/secured financing ban (4.8).

tiers.name: Chair
tiers.description: Distinguished only for clearance: the Chair seeks written approval from the Deputy Chair to trade during a Closed Period.

tiers.name: Executive
tiers.description: Distinguished only for clearance: an executive seeks written approval from the Managing Director to trade during a Closed Period, and has 5 business days (rather than 2) to confirm the trade to the Company Secretary.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: 'Associated parties' of a director, whose intended trading a director must notify to the Chair before dealing.

rules.detail: Outside the Directors and Executives regime, creating a derivative (including OTC options, swaps, hedges) over GWA securities is a Dealing swept in by the Securities/Dealing definitions, but not itself banned; it remains subject only to the overriding prohibition on dealing while possessing Inside Information.

rules.detail: Creating an OTC put/call over GWA securities is expressly a Dealing (creating 'a hedge, security interest ... or other financial interest') and Securities expressly includes over-the-counter options. bespoke_clauses.topic: absolute margin loan / secured financing ban
bespoke_clauses.clause: All directors and executives are prohibited from obtaining a margin loan using GWA securities (either solely or as part of a portfolio) as security for the loan or entering into any secured financing arrangement in respect of GWA securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This forecloses the loan leg of a funded collar entirely for any director or executive, regardless of vesting status, with no clearance or exceptional-circumstances pathway referenced anywhere in section 4.8.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no vesting carve-out for secured financing
bespoke_clauses.clause: Section 4.8 does not distinguish vested from unvested securities, unlike the hedging ban in 4.7 which is limited to unvested holdings.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even fully vested, unrestricted GWA shares cannot be pledged as loan collateral by a director or executive, a materially stricter position than the hedging restriction alone.

bespoke_clauses.clause: a disposal of GWA's securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights, for example, under a margin lending arrangement
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This legacy carve-out sits awkwardly with the absolute 4.8 ban on ever entering such an arrangement; a bank should not treat it as confirmation that secured financing over GWA shares is achievable.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors are required to notify the Chair of intended trading in GWA securities, by themselves or their associated parties, prior to such intended dealings.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even a permitted hedge dealt within the Window Period requires a director to separately notify the Chair beforehand, on top of any Closed Period written approval.

summary: GWA's policy imposes an absolute, vesting-independent ban on directors and executives obtaining a margin loan or entering any secured financing arrangement using GWA securities as collateral (clause 4.8), with no consent or exceptional-circumstances pathway. Because a funded OTC equity collar necessarily requires granting the bank security over the collared shares, the loan leg of the structure cannot be implemented by a GWA director or executive while they hold that role, even over fully vested, unrestricted shares. The hedge (put/call) component alone would be permitted once shares are vested, but only within a 30-day post-results/AGM Window Period (or a narrow Exceptional Circumstances approval), with prior written approval from the Chair, Deputy Chair or Managing Director as applicable, and never while in possession of Inside Information. Appendix A separately excludes a secured lender's enforcement sale from the policy, but this sits awkwardly with the blanket ban on entering such financing at all, so it should not be read as confirming the financing leg is available. Overall, the hedge could in principle be executed post-vesting with approval, but the bank-secured loan cannot, so a genuinely funded collar is not available to GWA directors or executives under this policy.
